document_title: Process Characterization Report — Cation Exchange Chromatography (Step 7)
schema_note: Blocks validate against nlp_reports app/models; parameter_type, document_type, QualityAttribute criticality fields, StudyDesign and DesignSpace are local extensions (see schema_extensions_used).
schema_extensions_used: ProvenAcceptableRange (new model) — per-response x parameter PAR (at-set-point / NOR-propagated); both responses use a drug-substance specification as the acceptance basis
RhetoricalSpan (new model) — argument-structure roles over the report prose
out_of_schema_notes: CEX sets no CQA; the QualityAttribute entities are the CQAs it controls/clears (formed upstream).

Pool aggregate and pool HCP are in-process responses with no released spec; reported via studies/report_sections. Both are judged against an in-process limit derived in §7.1, not against the DS criterion: for HCP the DS criterion is carried back through the AEX clearance and divided by a safety factor, for aggregate the DS criterion is the pool ceiling itself (no later step reduces it) and is divided by a larger safety factor.

Pool HCP above the DS criterion is the expected result for an intermediate and is not a failed acceptance criterion. Against the in-process limit the PAR analysis returns an interval for every parameter. The further AEX clearance is credited to PCR-008 and the cumulative position across the train to PCMR-001.
No response shows significant curvature, and the step-yield model is direction-only (predicted R^2 0.20); the two attribute models carry every prediction.
Process-capability (Cpk) values have no dedicated field; reported as report_sections statements.
proven_acceptable_ranges mirror @tbl-par (doe_report.par_table); rhetorical_spans are verbatim report prose; PCR-007 carries no weak_claims.

design_spaces.definition: The part of the characterized four-dimensional region in protein load, load/wash conductivity, elution buffer pH and the stop collect criterion in which both governed attributes stay within their in-process limits. Aggregate is the attribute that constrains it more, and the corner at which protein load, elution buffer pH and the stop collect criterion sit together at the unfavourable edge of their normal operating ranges lies outside the region: the prediction there is below the drug-substance limit but above the in-process limit, which is that limit divided by a safety factor because no downstream step removes aggregate. Pool host cell protein is judged against a limit carried back from the drug-substance criterion through the anion-exchange clearance.

statements.statement_text: No parameter at this step is a critical process parameter: the four quality-linked parameters are well-controlled critical process parameters, set or measured by instrumented systems, and the elution flow rate is a general process parameter.

source_references.quote: No parameter was classified as a critical process parameter. All four quality-linked parameters are set or measured by instrumented systems

statements.statement_text: Aggregate is reduced only at this step, so the aggregate capability of the drug substance rests on cation exchange in a way that the impurity capabilities, which are shared with other steps, do not.

source_references.quote: the aggregate capability of the drug substance rests on this step in a way that the impurity capabilities do not

statements.statement_text: Pool host cell protein is governed by the load and wash conductivity and by protein load, acting in opposite directions and through their interaction.

source_references.quote: Host cell protein levels were affected by load and wash conductivity and by protein load, in opposite directions, and a significant interaction between the two was identified

statements.statement_text: The pool aggregate and pool host cell protein response-surface models predict a withheld run about as well as they describe the runs they were fitted to, and both are used for prediction on that basis.

source_references.quote: which means the models predict a withheld run about as well as they describe the runs they were fitted to

statements.statement_text: No response shows significant curvature over the ranges studied: each response changes linearly with each parameter, the interactions carry the whole departure from additivity, and no edge of failure lies inside the characterized region.

source_references.quote: None of the four quadratic terms is significant in any of the three models. Over the ranges studied each response changes linearly with each parameter

source_reference.quote: cation exchange is the last step in the train that reduces the high molecular weight fraction, so no step after this one removes what this step leaves in the pool
It forms no quality attribute of its own.
Pool aggregate constrains the region more than pool host cell protein does.
The criterion this step is judged against is an in-process limit and not the drug-substance specification
Its host cell protein content is reduced again by the anion exchange step, so comparing the pool against the drug-substance criterion would report a failure that does not exist

Host cell protein, residual DNA and leached Protein A are cleared by Protein A capture, by this step and by anion exchange, and the ranges and controls those steps contribute are in PCR-005 and PCR-008
The outcomes of this step roll up into the master report PCMR-001.

A higher load and wash conductivity raises the ionic strength of the mobile phase, which screens the attraction between the sulfonate ligand and the weakly bound acidic host cell proteins and strips them from the column during the wash, while the antibody, which is held more strongly, stays bound

A heavily loaded column carries more weakly bound host cell protein into the wash, so a higher wash conductivity removes more from a heavily loaded column than from a lightly loaded one, and the interaction coefficient is negative
Host cell protein levels were affected by load and wash conductivity and by protein load, in opposite directions, and a significant interaction between the two was identified.
Host cell protein results near the limit of quantitation are therefore attributed to the assay unless a factor effect explains them
The screening study is therefore read here for which factors are active and in which direction
The residuals of both models are centred on zero and show no trend with the predicted value, so neither model is systematically wrong at one end of its range
The model confirms the protein load effect that screening found and is used for nothing else in this report.
Pool aggregate therefore changes linearly with each of the four parameters over this region, and the surface shows no maximum, no minimum and no edge of failure inside the ranges studied
The three interactions identified in screening are confirmed, and the interaction of protein load with elution buffer pH is again the largest
The design space of this step is the region of the four well-controlled critical process parameters over which pool aggregate and pool host cell protein remain within their in-process limits.
It is cleared by three chromatography steps in series, so its acceptable level at the cation exchange pool depends on what the anion exchange step downstream removes
The region is defined only over the ranges the study explored and says nothing about settings outside them.
Each proven acceptable range was determined twice, and the two answers differ because they answer different questions.
The corner is the simultaneous worst case of three or two independent parameters and is not a condition the process is run at.
The consequence for the control strategy is stated in Section 10
Capability at this step is shared with other steps and is not delivered by cation exchange alone.
Two bounds apply to every number in this section.
No parameter was classified as a critical process parameter.
The step does not act alone on any of them except aggregate.
The elements listed here are consolidated with those of the other steps in PCMR-001, which is the document that states the control strategy for the process as a whole.
What the model has not shown is that the small-scale column behaves like the commercial column at the edges of the ranges, because it was qualified at the target settings.
Both were detected after the affected run rather than during it, both were investigated to a root cause, and both were dispositioned as retained.
